**Decision:** The test image shows a whole banana plant cluster with completely dead/dried outer leaves while the central younger growth remains green, plus browning pseudostem sheaths at the base. This pattern — progressive outer-to-inner leaf death, wilting, and pseudostem discoloration — is the classic hallmark of Panama Disease (Fusarium wilt). The Bunchy_Top PlantWild_16 reference shows superficially similar dying outer leaves, but Bunchy_Top would cause stunted, narrow, bunched leaves rather than the normally-shaped leaves visible in the green center growth of the test image. The severe collapse and complete desiccation of outer leaves with new suckers emerging from the base is most consistent with Panama Disease.
